rows.grounds: milk plus from, fused source form

items.question: How should a practitioner fill that body with milk and fillings always?
premises: Milk is taken from its source.
The body is the object filled.
items.inference: The body is continually filled with milk and fillings.
uncertainties: The ellipsis token is unresolved in the source.
items.plain_english: From milk ... with fillings, one should always fill that body.
